goal: Deliver approved AI Native weekly-brief opportunities through one front-door human gate, automated implementation and verification, and a CI-green pull request ready for human review.

included: A repository-local weekly-brief delivery skill covering proposal, approval, isolated implementation, evidence, review, CI repair, and pull-request readiness
A strict deviation revisit rule that requires compliant repair or an explicitly approved superseding contract revision
A read-only GitHub Actions verification pipeline for pull requests and main
Updates to the existing Friday AI Engineering Brief automation so approved AI Native proposals use the delivery skill
excluded: Publishing or changing the public AI Engineering Brief
Merging, enabling auto-merge, releasing, deploying, publishing shared assets, or rolling changes out to consumers
Changing repository protection settings or editing the dirty primary checkout

sourceEvidence.claim: Scheduled tasks can produce the proposal in an existing task, while isolated worktrees keep implementation separate from the primary checkout.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The documentation does not define this repository's contract, deviation, evidence, or PR-readiness policy.

sourceEvidence.source: GitHub Actions billing and repository inspection
sourceEvidence.claim: The public repository can use standard GitHub-hosted Actions runners without custom credentials or per-minute charges, and its tests require full Git history.
sourceEvidence.limitations: GitHub policy and repository visibility can change; the workflow still requires a live run before readiness.

sourceEvidence.source: Existing AI Native task-contract and evidence validators
sourceEvidence.claim: The repository already has executable contract and evidence formats that can anchor approval and independent verification.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The existing evidence validator permits a same-revision approved deviation to verify, so rev 2 must close that loophole.

risks.statement: A loose deviation rule could let an implementation pass while no longer honoring the human-approved specification.
A shallow GitHub checkout would make history-sensitive repository tests fail despite a valid implementation.
The existing Friday automation could continue producing proposals that lack enough detail to freeze an executable contract.
Main is currently unprotected, so human merge discipline remains necessary until repository protection is separately authorized.

constraints.statement: Work only in a clean, dedicated worktree based on the recorded origin/main commit; do not disturb the user's dirty primary checkout.
No repository mutation may begin before explicit approval of the exact stable ID and revision.
Every deviation must trigger a revisit until the approved specification is honored or a new contract revision and fingerprint receive explicit human approval.

The pull request may be created and moved from draft to ready only after local verification, independent review, evidence validation, and GitHub CI succeed; it must never be merged by this delivery workflow.
GitHub Actions must use read-only repository permissions, pinned actions, the repository Node version, and full Git history.

assumptions.statement: The implementation worktree is based on the current origin/main commit recorded in this contract.
The existing GitHub connection can create and update a pull request, and repository SSH credentials can push the feature branch.
Standard GitHub-hosted Actions runners are available without billed minutes for this public repository.
The existing Friday AI Engineering Brief heartbeat is the automation to update rather than duplicate.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The weekly brief produces a complete, fingerprinted, proposal-only approval contract and performs no implementation mutation before explicit approval.
evidenceRequired: The weekly-brief-delivery skill defines exact proposal fields and a no-mutation stop
The Friday automation invokes that proposal workflow

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An approved item uses one isolated worktree, branch, task contract, evidence bundle, and draft pull request through implementation and verification.
evidenceRequired: Skill instructions define the one-item delivery unit and readiness gates
This delivery records a valid contract, commit-bound evidence, independent review, and pull request

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every deviation starts a revisit, and unresolved or same-revision approved deviations cannot verify or make a pull request ready.
evidenceRequired: Validator regression tests cover material and non-material unresolved deviations, same-revision approval, and repaired deviations
The skill and verification guidance require an approved superseding revision when the original contract cannot be honored

acceptanceCriteria.statement: GitHub CI runs the repository verification suite with read-only permissions, pinned actions, the .nvmrc version, and full Git history.
evidenceRequired: The CI workflow passes on the final pull-request commit
The workflow contains no write permission or pull_request_target trigger

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The existing Friday AI Engineering Brief automation is updated in place to use the contract, deviation, evidence, and pull-request workflow.
evidenceRequired: The automation retains its Friday schedule and target task
Its saved prompt invokes the weekly-brief-delivery skill and preserves proposal-only behavior until approval

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AIN-DELIVERY-001 rev 2 dogfoods the workflow and ends at a CI-green pull request ready for human review without merge or deployment.
evidenceRequired: The approved contract and commit-bound evidence validate
A fresh independent read-only reviewer verifies the final diff and evidence
The pull request is ready and every required GitHub check is green

allowedActions: Create and edit files only on the dedicated feature worktree and branch
Install lockfile-resolved dependencies and run repository verification
Update the existing Friday AI Engineering Brief automation in place
Commit and push the approved feature branch
Create and update one draft pull request and mark it ready after every readiness gate passes
Repair in-scope local or CI failures and rerun the required evidence and review loop
prohibitedActions: Release, deploy, publish shared assets, or roll out to consumer repositories
Change repository protection or security settings
Modify, clean, reset, or stash the dirty primary checkout
Expand scope, paths, authority, or acceptance boundaries without an approved superseding revision

humanGates.decision: Approve AIN-DELIVERY-001 rev 2 for bounded delivery through a pull request ready for human review.
Approve an exact superseding contract revision and fingerprint when the active revision cannot be honored safely.
humanGates.when: Only after the deviation revisit cannot restore compliance with the active approved revision.

humanGates.decision: Review and decide whether to merge the ready pull request.
humanGates.when: After the final commit, evidence, independent review, and required GitHub checks are green.
